'''Joseph Workman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Lacey tournament]] on 8 January 2000 with Operatives, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d168">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ lacey-washington-01082000], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 11 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
